newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican stocks reach new intraday high.
newsitem.headline: Mexican stocks reach new intraday high.

text.p: Mexican stocks extended early gains to a record midday high on Friday of 4,486.46 points on the IPC index, up 21.48 points from Thursday's close.
The market opened up on left-over buy orders from the end of trade on Thursday, dealers said.
The previous intraday record was 4,473.95 points hit on June 20.
The market has overshot analyst expectations by a fair bit. In a Reuters survey MEX28, brokerages forecast a top level of 4,236.03 points by June 30.
"After respecting resistance at 4,380 points, it gave the signal for more buy orders," Inverlat brokerage analyst Hector Jimenez said.
"In pesos, I would say the market is overvalued, gains now are extra. However, foreigners continue buying because in dollar terms they are still buying opportunities," he said.
In steady trade, volume was 1,509 transactions, or 24.09 million shares at midday.
